item_titles: The Tokenpocalypse Is Here: Companies Are Scrambling To Stop Spending So Much on AI
Lessons from Reducing My Coding Agent's LLM API Costs
After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
clusters.summary: 随着AI消耗呈指数级增长，各公司正急于控制大模型带来的巨额API开销。Rippling等公司因自身账单超标推出了AI支出追踪控制台，也有开发者分享了降低编程智能体成本的经验。
clusters.title: 企业面临大模型高昂Token成本挑战并推出应对工具

item_titles: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.

clusters.title: 亚马逊推进AI数据中心建设引发环境与社区争议

item_titles: 当题库追不上模型，AI开始给自己出题：中国这支团队跑通了数据层RSI

Making AI Smarter with AI

clusters.title: 利用AI自我生成数据与全栈自进化训练下一代模型

item_titles: 180万刀，连亚马逊都烧不起Claude了

clusters.title: GPT-5.6低成本复刻游戏引发对Claude Opus高昂Token消耗的讨论

item_titles: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans
Anthropic sets Claude Code to Auto Mode by default to protect developers from bad approvals

clusters.title: Anthropic将Claude Code的Auto模式设为默认

item_titles: Scammers are enrolling fake students at US community colleges and using AI to collect financial aid

clusters.title: 骗子利用AI在美国社区大学骗取助学金

clusters.title: FAIth：由LLM前端编译的无语法JVM语言

item_titles: The Long, AI-Powered Quest to Perfect Pringle-Making

item_titles: Google Deepmind's WeatherNext predicts cyclone tracks and intensity at the same time

item_titles: Advanced AI Sycophancy

clusters.title: 探讨高级AI的谄媚问题

item_titles: China created a system that simulates the Earth with billions of AI agents

clusters.title: 中国创建包含数十亿AI智能体的地球模拟系统

item_titles: Generative AI threatens to upend citizen science records

clusters.title: 生成式AI威胁公民科学记录的真实性

item_titles: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-Gen. Code via Semantic Triangulation (OOPSLA 26)

clusters.title: 通过语义三角化减少大模型生成代码的幻觉

item_titles: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns

Responding to the next frontier of critical cyber capabilities

clusters.title: OpenAI因安全担忧放缓Astra模型开发

item_titles: AI is flooding Britain's employment courts with lawsuits
clusters.summary: 截至2026年3月，英国就业法庭的诉讼案件激增39%，其中大量诉状由ChatGPT或Grok生成。这导致案件积压量跃升55%。
clusters.title: AI生成的诉讼文件充斥英国就业法庭

item_titles: Google's DiffusionGemma proves you don't need to train from scratch to build a text diffusion model
clusters.summary: Google DeepMind通过改造Gemma 4模型推出了DiffusionGemma，无需从零开始训练即可构建文本扩散模型，且仅使用了不到10%的原始训练预算。
clusters.title: Google DeepMind推出DiffusionGemma文本扩散模型
